questions.question: D3 — Which review mode should I use for this test coverage plan? <gstack-qid:ceo-mode-selection>

options.label: SCOPE EXPANSION — Dream big, propose ambitious version
options.description: Push scope up. Surface the 10x version of this test suite (property-based tests, mutation testing, chaos scenarios). Every expansion is your opt-in.

options.label: SELECTIVE EXPANSION — Hold scope, cherry-pick extras
options.description: Hold the two-test baseline. Surface expansion opportunities individually (e.g. contract assertions, mock-call-count checks). You choose which to add.

options.label: HOLD SCOPE — Maximum rigor (Recommended)
options.description: Accept the plan's scope (two minimal tests). Review it with maximum rigor: architecture, error paths, edge cases, observability. No expansions surfaced. Default for test coverage plans.

options.label: SCOPE REDUCTION — Strip to essentials
options.description: Find the minimum viable version. Ruthlessly cut anything that isn’t absolutely required.

answers.D3 — Which review mode should I use for: SCOPE EXPANSION — Dream big, propose ambitious version
